text:
- [RARC.13.2] **Process boundaries are integrator-picked.**
  Co-locate tiers in one process for tight-latency
  cooperation; split across processes for independent
  restart, remote topology, or tier-to-tier fan-in.
  ([RARC.2.4]). Adapters and storage backends may
  run as separate processes for crash isolation.
gap_reason: Process placement is the integrator's choice. Outside the engine and the harness.
